items.title: Curfew imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after rioting across France
items.description: It comes after the country's interior minister admits that police "lost control" in some cities.

items.title: Ukrainians dying because US restricting intelligence sharing, Zelensky adviser tells BBC
items.description: Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.

items.title: Kenya cult leader who told parents to starve children guilty of 191 murders
items.description: Self-proclaimed pastor Paul Mackenzie was found guilty of 191 murder charges - all but one of them children.

items.title: Tennis star Svitolina says emotional toll of Ukraine war led to Monfils separation
items.description: The two top tennis pros married in 2021 and have one child together.

items.title: Five ways El Niño is affecting the weather around the world
items.description: As the strongest El Niño on record continues to intensify, what impacts on weather patterns are already being felt across the globe? Sarah Keith-Lucas looks at the evidence.

items.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
items.description: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

items.title: Exiled critic of Rwandan president found beheaded
items.description: Former army sergeant major Robert Kabera was a popular YouTuber and singer, who had sought asylum in Uganda.

items.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 50 security recruits, local authorities say
items.description: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province that officials say was being used as a training centre for new recruits.

items.title: US airman dies as daredevil descent goes wrong before Texas college football game
items.description: The game continued after the incident. The American Conference said the decision was made before his death was known.

items.title: Obama blasts federal probe of congresswoman Ilhan Omar as 'so appalling'
items.description: Obama says federal agents' search of the Democrat's home was an effort to intimidate a Trump critic.

items.title: Personal attacks fire up debate before Brazil's run-off vote
items.description: The race heats up just days before the run-off between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing challenger.

items.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'
items.description: The blaze that killed four men and injured dozens of others spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.
